title: Top-k expert routing from one routing description (heterogeneous-expert-dispatch)
description: heterogeneous-expert-dispatch's Routing and its host reference: softmax or sigmoid scores before or after selection, a per-expert correction bias that only changes the selection, group limits, renormalization and scaling, ties to the lower expert id. The reference a device routing kernel is checked against; its device form runs the same rule over a step's router logits, through crit's kernel topk-routing (one launch, a warp per token row; built on this GPU, tuned or default knobs) where it builds and the rule has no group limit, in torch otherwise; capture-safe (no host synchronization; a captured round's or prompt chunk's junk rows of NaN logits still pick valid distinct experts, with weights 0: rounds:router, prompts:router).

kernel.description: select through crit's kernel topk-routing (built on this GPU, tuned or default knobs) where it builds (rules without a group limit); false: torch

kernels.name: topk-routing
kernels.fallback: the same rule in torch (softmax or sigmoid, a stable sort for the selection): capture-safe, about fifteen launches a call

router.about: expert routing: scores, top-k and the routing description experts read

host.route: route(logits, top, bias=None) -> [(expert ids, weights)]: one per token's router logits row

device.select: select(logits, top, bias=None) -> (ids, weights): each token's routed experts ([tokens][top] int64, in selection order) and their weights ([tokens][top] FP32) from its router logits row ([tokens][experts]), by the host form's rule
